mathematical_authority.exact_point_kind: ExactRationalWitness is used only when Real::exact_rational_ref is present; a non-rational exact scalar remains an IsolatingInterval representation even when an exact point is stored.
mathematical_authority.collapsed_import: A cached-valid unit singleton is collapsed only when lower == upper structurally. Merely policy-equal or approximately equal endpoints are not promoted.
mathematical_authority.arithmetic_status: ComputedExactRationalWitness, ComputedExactRealWitness, and ComputedRepresentation are the only result-bearing success statuses. Consumers still reject a success report that omits both result carriers.
mathematical_authority.policy: STRICT success returns before any approximate retry. Invalid cached evidence is replayed and rejected under STRICT even for an APPROXIMATE_512 caller.
mathematical_authority.coordinate_order: The existing fixed [x,y] rational-image batch, common denominator, coefficient order, and retained curve-family cache identity are unchanged.

regression_evidence.pre_fix: Four new library regressions failed independently for wrong kind, rejected exact-Real tangent scalar, rejected exact-Real arrangement negation, and retained collapsed parameter wrapper. The public rational-point image also failed its new truthful parameter-kind assertion.

benchmark_method.baseline: one complete pre-change process after release compilation
benchmark_method.post: five direct executions of the freshly built release benchmark; medians below
benchmark_method.caveat: The retained bridge changes do not alter the benchmark's work counts. The pre-change sample is not a multi-process statistical control, so small timing deltas are reported as noise rather than attributed speedups or regressions.

wall_performance.interpretation: The existing parameter/image lanes remain timing-neutral at this measurement resolution. Exact-Real arithmetic now avoids a redundant APPROXIMATE_512 retry after STRICT success, but this private status path is not isolated by the public benchmark.

release_artifacts.reason: The reopened Hypercurve worktree already contains a concurrent 9500-line offset change, so no byte-matched pre-bridge artifact exists. Absolute artifacts are recorded without attributing their size to this slice.
